title: Regressor of the Fallen Family
altTitles: The Regressor of the Ruined Family
The Regressor of the Fallen Family
滅亡した家門の回帰者
没落した家門の回帰者
Le Régresseur de la Famille Déchue
El Regresor de la Familia Caída
Hồi Quy Giả Của Gia Tộc Sụp Đổ
description: A life filled with regrets. After realizing his mistakes and deciding to change, it is already too late—his family has been destroyed. Consumed by rage and regret, he eventually dies after losing everything. His final wish reaches the heavens, giving him another chance. Returning to the past, he raises his sword once more and fights against fate to prevent the destruction of his family.
author: Yang Pyung / Painkiller
